title: DeParadigm Media Visuals Manifest
description: Tracks automated media generation assets across scenes for ComfyUI, Motion, and Final Cut Pro pipeline integration.

project_id.description: Unique project identifier binding this manifest to a specific FCP timeline.

scenes.description: Ordered list of scenes requiring automated visual asset generation.

timestamp_start.description: Scene start time on the FCP timeline (HH:MM:SS or HH:MM:SS:FF).

timestamp_end.description: Scene end time on the FCP timeline (HH:MM:SS or HH:MM:SS:FF).

comfyui_prompt_target.description: Full prompt string dispatched to the local ComfyUI generation node for this scene's background or character frame.

motion_template_id.description: Reference to the Apple Motion template file used for this scene (e.g., 'TechSlide_v2', 'StatEquation_Anim').

fcp_layer_assignment.description: Target FCP timeline layer name or index where the rendered asset is composited (e.g., 'L3_TextOverlays', 'spine/primary').
